text:
Let’s use a machine learning model to find more earthquakes!

In this challenge, you will use a machine learning (ML) model to do much the same activity as you did yesterday.

Instructions

1) In the "File" menu in the top left of the workspace, click "Open". Then, select your document from yesterday.

2) Once that is open, click the "File" menu again and select "Make a Copy". This will make sure you can use yesterday's work to compare with the signals you found today!

3) In your WaveRunner from yesterday, we will now run the ML model on the same data. From the Model list, select "compact model."

4) In the bottom control bar of the WaveRunner, click the "Play" button.

5) When it is finished running, click the "Timeline It!" button in the bottom control bar of the WaveRunner.

6) Answer Questions 3, 4, and 5.
